title: Sharp Minimax Risk for Causal Sinkhorn Divergence at Critical Entropy
banked_reason: terminal:laundering (kernel substitution): the sharp 90%-honest connected-interval value, its all-procedure lower transfer, and the derived limiting experiment/certified value remain expressly open; independent validity review confirms no bounded same-topic repair.
gap_reasons: The proved explicit, attaining point-risk curve is a genuine usable Stat contribution, but it substitutes for the promised joint original-data precision deliverable: the sharp 90%-honest connected-interval value, its all-procedure lower transfer, and the derived limiting experiment/certified value remain expressly open.
The sharp connected-interval value and full likelihood--value experiment remain open.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived and independently checked the exact full-model point-risk curve with a total attaining estimator, an all-n at-least-90%-honest connected interval upper construction, and certified auxiliary Gaussian slice values; final D0.5 mathematics passed and all four citations were verified. The committed joint precision kernel did not land: the coupled all-procedure interval lower experiment, connected-action reduction, sharp interval value and matching sharp attainment remain open, so independent validity review confirmed terminal:laundering in the pipeline kernel-substitution sense. No mathematical refutation or concealed-gap claim is made; preserve these informal partial results, but do not rewrite the topic into a point-risk-only kernel or infer sharp interval equality from the upper construction.
tldr: The sharp point-risk limit for the finite-sample causal Sinkhorn target is \(\max\{\sqrt2/(9\sqrt\kappa),2\sqrt{2/\pi_{\mathrm{circ}}}\}\), uniformly on every compact subset of positive entropy parameters, with a total original-record estimator attaining it. A legal moving-tail family supplies the hidden-residual endpoint, and a directly proved four-cell LAN path supplies the ordinary mean-noise endpoint. The full raw cubic-moment model also admits exactly honest connected intervals with vanishing additional scaled length from pilot uncertainty, smoothing, padding, and numerical approximation. The sharp connected-interval value and full likelihood--value experiment remain open.
gap: The bounded-support analysis in \cite{GenevayChizatBachCuturiPeyre2019}, Theorem 3, and the fixed-entropy causal theory in \cite{pmlr-v306-agarwal26c} do not determine precision for moving arbitrary-Borel laws under only cubic moments. A quantitative residual separation makes the missing regime explicit; a Gaussian ambiguity calculation alone does not determine its original-data decision values.
fill: The field contribution derives the joint original-record likelihood and transport-value experiment and its computable precision values, with all-procedure lower transfer and exactly honest attainment on \(\mathcal M\). The atomic coverage prototype first tests whether pilot uncertainty and coverage repair admit vanishing scaled-length overhead. Its outcome determines the required observable states without changing the full model or finite target.
